def verify(conn_info, proxies):
    if conn_info.issuer_certificate_der is None:
        with Session() as session:
            try:
                raw = session.get(hint_ca_issuers[0])
            except RequestException:
                pass
            else:
                if raw.status_code and 300 > raw.status_code >= 200:
                    if raw.content is not None:
                        issuer_certificate = Certificate(raw.content)
